annotations.title: Autonomous Readability Article Body & Byline Extractor

description: Extracts primary article body, author bylines, publication timestamps, and estimated reading duration from web pages. Use when stripping navigation bars, advertisement containers, and cookie banners to isolate core editorial content; for converting full HTML to markdown, use extract_clean_markdown instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('readability_profile' defaults to 'article_body_strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Target web page HTML containing the article, editorial post, or blog content.

include_byline.description: Whether to parse author names, affiliations, and editorial publication dates.

readability_profile.description: Content isolation heuristic: strict article body, technical documentation, or forum thread.

name: scrape_readable_article

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for scrape_readable_article.

byline.description: Author credit or publishing editorial team.

excerpt.description: Short leading synopsis or meta description.

reading_time_minutes.description: Estimated reading duration in minutes based on 220 WPM.
